symptom: Recovery supervisor falsely failed after breaking a jq-to-while pipeline under set -euo pipefail.
A workflow could fail before jobs existed because a YAML plain scalar contained ': ' inside an if expression.
github_main terminal evidence accepted a verified observed SHA without requiring equality to canonical main_sha.
Terminal evidence HTTP 422 responses were retried with curl -f while the response body containing the actual rejection reason was discarded.
root_cause: Control-plane shell treated expected consumer early-exit as producer failure.
Workflow syntax was not serialized safely for YAML parsing.
Terminal evidence semantics checked verification but omitted exact main identity equality.
Transport error handling prioritized generic retry over diagnostic evidence preservation.
prevention: Under pipefail, never use producer | while ... break for bounded selection; use process substitution, mapfile, or another construction that cannot turn expected consumer exit into producer SIGPIPE failure.
Quote complete GitHub Actions if expressions whenever embedded string literals contain YAML-significant ': ' or similar parser hazards; validate workflow parseability before relying on runtime jobs.
For production_readback_mode=github_main require production_observed_sha === main_sha in addition to verified=true and null run/deploy identities.
For terminal API writeback capture HTTP status and sanitized response body before failing; never use an option that discards the only root-cause evidence.
Exact-head BRAIN, CodeQL and Required must be green before protected merge; reuse existing sibling runs instead of duplicating expensive CI.
A chat or agent keeps ownership through merge, production readback, canonical learning/prevention writeback, skill projection readback and writer-lease release.
Regression tests for human-readable policy/skill surfaces must assert semantic invariants and required concepts, not incidental word order or prose phrasing.

When reconciling an open PR onto current main, never transiently move its branch ref to exactly main and only then reapply the delta; GitHub may auto-close the PR. Build the full current-main-union tree plus candidate delta first, create one commit with current main as parent, then atomically move the branch ref.

Before GitHub create_tree-based reconciliation, require a non-empty verified base_tree_sha from the exact current main commit; after building the candidate tree and before moving the branch ref, enforce expected-scope/diff-size guardrails so an accidental repository-wide deletion or amplification fails closed.
failed_approaches: Blind rerun after generic red status.
Treating merge or auto-merge as terminal completion.
Assuming a 422 was caused by the latest code change without preserving the endpoint rejection body.
Over-specific prose regex that failed despite the required status + response-body contract being present.
Force-moving an open PR branch to exactly current main before reapplying its delta, which allowed GitHub to auto-close the PR during the transient-equal state.
Calling create_tree without a verified base_tree_sha, which produced a partial root tree and a candidate diff deleting thousands of unrelated files.
